disputes.title: How many trophies are hidden?

sideA.text: 28 hidden trophies (27 Bronze + 1 Gold), 27 visible.

sideB.text: GTASpotter counts 26 that spoil the story or are hidden.

disputes.verdict: 28 per the PSN tables. GTASpotter's 26 uses a different bucket (story-spoiling OR hidden), so both can be right under different definitions.

disputes.title: The Shootist: Silver or Bronze?

sideA.text: The Shootist is a Silver trophy.

sideB.text: OneMoreGame lists The Shootist as Bronze.

disputes.verdict: Silver — six sources against one.

disputes.title: OneMoreGame's grade split doesn't add up

sideA.text: OneMoreGame prints a split of 1 Platinum, 3 Gold, 14 Silver, 18 Bronze.

sideB.text: The same page's own list holds 55 trophies — and 1 + 3 + 14 + 18 is 36, not 55.

disputes.verdict: The split is internally inconsistent. The agreed split is 1 Platinum, 2 Gold, 6 Silver, 46 Bronze.

disputes.title: Platinum time: 200 hours or 300+?

sideA.text: About 200 hours to the platinum.

sideB.text: Push Square says up to 300 hours or more.

disputes.verdict: 200 hours is the consensus of five guides; Push Square's higher figure is noted, not adopted.

disputes.title: Race Challenge golds for 100%: 10 or 30?

sideA.text: 100% needs 10 of 13 Race Challenge gold medals.

sideB.text: Push Square's checklist says 30.

disputes.verdict: 10 of 13 — five sources against one, and Push Square's page is marked work in progress.

disputes.title: Bad Luck, I Guess: solved or unconfirmed?

sideA.text: PowerPyx gives a full method: re-rob the Little Cuba Payday Loans store as Lucia, alone, and escape on foot.

sideB.text: KeenGamer lists Bad Luck, I Guess as unconfirmed.

disputes.verdict: Present the PowerPyx method as reported, with KeenGamer still unconfirmed — not settled fact.

disputes.title: The Truth Is Out There: UFO method or unconfirmed?

sideA.text: PowerPyx and game-checklists give a UFO method: north-west of Starlet Motel, Kelly County, after 2AM, alone.

sideB.text: KeenGamer lists The Truth Is Out There as unconfirmed.

disputes.verdict: Two sources now agree on the method; KeenGamer still unconfirmed. OutputLag's variant telling is a separate dispute (D26). Note the game-checklists page contradicts itself: its intro says no confirmed trigger, then it gives the full method.

disputes.title: Ten Pin: bike-kick method or unconfirmed?

sideA.text: PowerPyx and game-checklists report kicking 10 pedestrians with Square from a bike, within 60 seconds.

sideB.text: KeenGamer says the precise method is still being confirmed.

disputes.verdict: Two sources agree on the bike-kick method; KeenGamer still unconfirmed.

disputes.title: In The Beginning…: rooftop bar or unconfirmed?

sideA.text: PowerPyx and game-checklists report the Ocean View Rooftop Bar: buy an Apple Martini, drink it by the bar.

sideB.text: KeenGamer says the exact trigger is still being confirmed.

disputes.verdict: Two sources agree on the Apple Martini / Ocean View Rooftop Bar method; KeenGamer still unconfirmed.

disputes.title: Capital Offense: blue Banshee or unconfirmed?

sideA.text: PowerPyx and game-checklists report stealing the blue Banshee from the south Vice City showroom and driving it through the window.

sideB.text: KeenGamer says the exact method is unconfirmed.

disputes.verdict: Two sources agree on the blue Banshee + Key Cloner method; KeenGamer still unconfirmed.

disputes.title: Meditation maths: 18 or 20?

sideA.text: 10 spots × 2 characters should be 20 meditations — EGamers flags that the numbers don't line up.

sideB.text: The counter is 18.

disputes.verdict: 18. Spot 1 counts once, the 8 middle spots count twice, the Ascent counts once: 1 + 16 + 1.

disputes.title: Is the Chapter 1 meditation required?

sideA.text: The Chapter 1 meditation raises the progress counter by 1.

sideB.text: It is not marked as a Meditation Spot like the rest.

disputes.verdict: UNCONFIRMED on both sides. Safe play: do it in Chapter 1.

disputes.title: Vehicle totals: 557 or 277?

sideA.text: PowerPyx lists 557 vehicles exist at launch.

sideB.text: 277 base models.

disputes.verdict: Both true, different denominators — 557 including variants, 277 base models. The checklist needs 200 of 277 scanned.

disputes.title: Shooting ranges: 12 locations or 2 ranges?

sideA.text: PowerPyx's sub-guide title says 12 Shooting Range Locations.

sideB.text: 2 physical ranges holding 12 challenges and 42 golds.

disputes.verdict: 2 ranges, 12 challenges, 42 golds — 18 at Griffin, 24 at Rodgers Ranch.

disputes.title: Shooting challenges: 12 or 14?

sideA.text: PowerPyx's wiki hub says 14 Shooting Range Challenges (42 Gold Medals).

sideB.text: The main guide, the checklist, GTADB and CryptoGames all say 12 challenges.

disputes.verdict: 12 — PowerPyx's own main guide agrees with the other sources against its wiki hub.

disputes.title: Which Strangers & Freaks strands count?

sideA.text: PowerPyx confirms 4 counting strands (Kirk, Kyle, Yago, Pete) and says more are yet to be discovered.

sideB.text: Other lists state 8 strands and name the exclusions (Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy don't count).

disputes.verdict: Partially confirmed: 8 strands are needed, 4 are confirmed, the rest are still being mapped.

disputes.title: Which chapter is the finale in?

sideA.text: PowerPyx ties You Gotta Know When to Get Off to Chapter 4's Starting From Zero.

sideB.text: The same guide lists Snow Storm under Chapter 5, and KeenGamer says the story has five chapters.

disputes.verdict: UNRESOLVED — PowerPyx's own text is inconsistent here. This guide does not state the finale's chapter.

disputes.title: Per-trophy Gamerscore: varied or flat?

sideA.text: GamesFuze and ViceCityHustle print varied per-trophy Gamerscore values.

sideB.text: ofzenandcomputing claims flat values: Gold 100G, Silver 50G, Bronze 10G.

disputes.verdict: Unsettled — EGamers omits per-trophy values for exactly this reason. This guide prints only the 1,000G total and A Long Road at 100G.

disputes.title: Do stranger chains have story windows?

sideA.text: TechWiser, via EGamers, says the stranger chains behind five hidden trophies have story-linked windows.

sideB.text: PowerPyx and KeenGamer say all trophy quest-givers return after the story.

disputes.verdict: NOT directly verified — second-hand, single source. Watch item only, not a confirmed missable.

disputes.title: How many WAiNK objects exist in total?

sideA.text: PowerPyx lists 31 Landmarks + 35 Curiosities + 23 Sculptures + No Flusher tags (no count given) — 89 plus tags.

sideB.text: The trophy needs any 100 scans, and more than 100 locations exist.

disputes.verdict: Not stated in any source read. The trophy is safe (any 100 count), but no total object count is published here.

disputes.title: Smash 'N' Grabs: 34 of 35, or just 34?

sideA.text: 34 of 35 Smash 'N' Grabs for 100%.

sideB.text: Push Square lists 34 with no total.

disputes.verdict: 34 of 35 — three sources against an abbreviated work-in-progress listing.

disputes.title: Fair Game: which animal?

sideA.text: PowerPyx says it is still being confirmed which animal unlocks Fair Game.

sideB.text: KeenGamer just says hunt a unique animal for Bret.

disputes.verdict: UNCONFIRMED — the questline is confirmed, the exact triggering animal is not.

disputes.title: Meditations: 18 or 15?

sideA.text: The trophy needs 18 meditations.

sideB.text: 100% needs 15 of 18.

disputes.verdict: Not a true dispute — different targets. (HappyGamer wrongly says only 15 of 18 are needed for the trophy.)

disputes.title: Let's Go Bowling: which method?

sideA.text: GTABase, OutputLag, game-checklists and the gang-operations checklist give a 3-valuables gang-operation method.

sideB.text: Push Square says steal the three key valuables at the bowling alley and escape; other sources give the description only.

disputes.verdict: Closed toward the 3-valuables method (watch, shotgun, office safe, escape the police) — OutputLag and game-checklists now corroborate it from two more sources; Push Square's telling now matches the consensus rather than differing.

disputes.title: Cal's fish: 2 kg or 2 lbs?

sideA.text: PowerPyx — Cal asks for a Parrotfish over 2 kg.

sideB.text: OutputLag fishing guide + game-checklists achievements — catch a Stoplight Parrotfish over 2 lbs (about 0.91 kg) and send Cal the photo.

disputes.verdict: 2 lbs. Two sources against one, and the pound figure matches the in-game objective text quoted by OutputLag ("a stoplight parrotfish larger than 2 lbs"). The r5 claim text is corrected to 2 lbs.

disputes.title: The Truth Is Out There: whose UFO telling?

sideA.text: PowerPyx + game-checklists — road north-west of Starlet Motel, Kelly County, alone at night after 2AM; blinking car; follow the path into the woods to the blue light; help the dropped-off woman, walk her back to her car; the UFO takes you and you wake up three days later.

sideB.text: OutputLag side-missions — alien abduction near the Starlet Motel triggered by Lucia in Chapter 2: abandoned car with flickering lights, trail of clothes into the woods, floating woman; getting her car back ends with Lucia abducted.

disputes.verdict: Two sources agree on the detailed method (side A), so present that as the reported method. OutputLag's telling differs on protagonist, chapter and outcome and may describe a separate abduction event — needs in-game confirmation before either is treated as settled.

disputes.title: A Classic Blitz Play: does a bank vault count?

sideA.text: GTABase + game-checklists — robbing a large bank vault also counts, as long as you escape afterwards.

sideB.text: PowerPyx — armored truck only. (OutputLag's trophy list gives the description "Rob an Armored Truck and escape" with no method.)

disputes.verdict: Lean vault-counts — two sources against one explicit truck-only telling. Present as reported; the field needs one in-game confirmation.

disputes.title: Pest Control: 8 gangs or 9?

sideA.text: OutputLag trophy list + businesses — rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the nine gangs.

sideB.text: game-checklists gang-ops — 39 operations run by 8 gangs, plus a handful of other criminal fronts (13 independent-front operations).

disputes.verdict: UNSETTLED — the gap is definitional: whether independent criminal fronts count as a ninth gang. Arbiter is the in-game Progress > Gangs counter, which both sides agree tracks the count per gang.
